summary: YAML inventory example with all hosts and vars, nested child groups, a host in multiple groups, and a warning to always put a colon after host names.
questions: Why does my YAML inventory only pick up one host in a group?
Do I need a colon after each host name in YAML inventory?
Can a host belong to multiple groups in YAML inventory?
Does key order matter in YAML inventory?

answer_card.title: YAML inventory example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
all:
  hosts:
    test1:
    test2:
      host_var: value
  vars:
    group_all_var: value
  children:
    other_group:
      children:
        group_x:
          hosts:
            test5     # one host without a colon works...
        group_y:
          hosts:
            test6:    # ...but always use a colon
      vars:
        g2_var2: value3
      hosts:
        test4:
          ansible_host: 127.0.0.1
    last_group:
      hosts:
        test1:        # same host, extra group membership
      vars:
        group_last_var: value
```

Keys must be unique (one `hosts` per group). Key order doesn't matter; indentation does. Listing several hosts **without colons** breaks.
